name: mindora
description: Mindora – AI-powered personalised learning and academic assistance platform

scripts.dev:real: node scripts/preflight.mjs && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.api:local: cross-env CHALLENGE_ANY_DAY=true DATA_STORE=memory FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-mindora FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.test:server: firebase emulators:exec --only auth --project demo-mindora "npm --prefix server test"
